theorems.name: Submission.arp_rgr_graph_map_fderiv
theorems.statement: ∀ {n ℓ : ℕ} (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (v : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (y : Amb n ℓ) (U : Set (Rn n)), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 v U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => y + q (graphPoint x (v x))) U ∧ ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ h : Rn n, fderiv ℝ (fun x => y + q (graphPoint x (v x))) x h = q (graphPoint h (fderiv ℝ v x h))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
